map.拣货员沿通道行进，到端部后进入下一相邻通道，形成连续 S 形轨迹。适合拣货点分布: The picker moves along an aisle, enters the next adjacent aisle at the end, and forms a continuous S-shaped path. Suited to evenly distributed pick points and long aisles, with a continuous route and no backtracking.
map.拣货员进入通道拣货后原路返回，从同一端进入下一通道。适合拣货点集中在通道一端、通: The picker enters an aisle, picks, then returns the same way and enters the next aisle from the same end. Suited to pick points concentrated at one end of the aisle, short aisles, or picking order by order.
map.路径距离为理论估算，假设出入口位于第一通道前端、拣货点均匀分布。实际距离受货位分: Route distance is a theoretical estimate, assuming the entrance and exit are at the front of the first aisle and that pick points are evenly distributed. Actual distance is affected by slot layout, turning to reach goods and other factors.
map.S 型（穿越式）与 U 型（返回式）定量对比：S 型通道内行走距离=通道数×通道: Quantitative comparison of S-shape (traversal) and U-shape (return): in-aisle walking distance for S-shape = number of aisles × aisle length, and for U-shape = 2 × number of aisles × aisle length (each aisle is entered and then retraced); the cross-aisle distance is the same for both, namely (number of aisles − 1) × aisle spacing.
map.行走与拣货耗时拆分：行走耗时=总行走距离÷行走速度，拣货耗时=拣货点总数×单点拣: Breaking down walking and picking time: walking time = total walking distance ÷ walking speed, picking time = total pick points × time per pick point (total pick points = number of aisles × pick points per aisle); picking time does not depend on the route, so the entire difference comes from walking distance.

map.算例：8 通道仓库的 S 型 vs U 型对比: Worked example: S-shape vs U-shape in an 8-aisle warehouse
map.输入：通道数 8、通道长 20 m、通道间距 3 m、行走速度 1.2 m/s、: Input: 8 aisles, aisle length 20 m, aisle spacing 3 m, walking speed 1.2 m/s, 10 s per pick point, 3 pick points per aisle. Total pick points = 8 × 3 = 24, picking time = 24 × 10 = 240 s. S-shape: in-aisle 8 × 20 = 160 m, cross-aisle (8 − 1) × 3 = 21 m, total 181.0 m, walking 150.83 s, total time 390.83 s (6 min 31 s). U-shape: in-aisle 8 × 20 × 2 = 320 m, cross-aisle 21 m, total 341.0 m, walking 284.17 s, total time 524.17 s (8 min 44 s). Conclusion: S-shape is recommended, saving 133.33 s, a saving ratio of 25.4%. With another set of parameters (4 aisles, length 30 m, spacing 3 m, 1.2 m/s, 15 s per point, 5 points per aisle) S-shape is 407.5 s and U-shape 507.5 s, a saving of 100.0 s (19.7%).
map.什么情况下 U 型反而更优？: When is the U-shape actually better?
map.当拣货点集中在少数通道、或通道很长而横向间距很小、且允许只进入需要拣货的通道时，: When pick points are concentrated in a few aisles, or aisles are very long while the cross-aisle spacing is very small, and only the aisles that need picking may be entered, the U-shape can skip irrelevant aisles and end up shorter. This tool, however, models every aisle as entered and walked in full, so the U-shape distance is always twice the S-shape in-aisle distance and S-shape always wins under this model; if the real operation only walks part of the aisles, convert manually using the actual number of aisles.
map.为什么两条路径的拣货耗时是一样的？: Why is the picking time the same for both routes?
map.拣货点总数由通道数与每通道拣货点决定，单点拣货时间也是固定输入，都不随路径策略变: The total number of pick points is set by the number of aisles and the pick points per aisle, and the time per pick point is also a fixed input; neither changes with the route strategy, so picking time is the same. This means route optimization can only compress walking time; if the efficiency bottleneck comes from the picking action itself (such as unpacking, scanning or labelling), the fix lies in workstation layout or packaging method.
